newsitem.title: UK: Royal Bank of Scotland marked up on results.
newsitem.headline: Royal Bank of Scotland marked up on results.

text.p: Shares in Royal Bank of Scotland were marked higher in pre-market dealings on Thursday after the bank announced full-year profits at the top end of expectations.
Royal Bank of Scotland shares were indicated 3-1/2p higher at 525-1/2p. The broader market was indicated steady.

The bank said annual pretax profit rose to 695 million pounds in the year to September 30 from 602 million a year earlier. Analysts had forecast full-year pretax profits of between 600 million pounds and 689 million.
"The figures look nicely in line at first glance. The shares should be good for a couple more pence," one marketmaker said.
